title: The Paradox of Reality
designPurpose: A mineral page split by restrained rift lines, where perception and reality sit close but never perfectly overlap.

semanticPageTypes.cover: Official cover appears first, unnumbered, contained without cropping.
semanticPageTypes.titlePage: Source title-page paragraphs are centered as a conceptual frontispiece; title paragraph receives the display treatment.
semanticPageTypes.contents: TOC source lines keep manuscript order with arc and chapter hierarchy.
semanticPageTypes.chapterOpening: Reality is staged as a controlled fracture between what is seen and what is believed. Chapter openers begin on fresh pages with restrained rule geometry.
semanticPageTypes.normalContinuation: Warm ivory paper, deep text, comfortable literary spacing, source paragraph anchors retained.
semanticPageTypes.sectionBreak: Small dual-rule mark in accent and warm counterpoint.
semanticPageTypes.pageNumbers: Small sans-serif numerals placed by the shared engine at the page foot.
semanticPageTypes.finalManuscriptPage: Ending, epilogue, and author pages carry a quieter lower-page wash.
semanticPageTypes.feedbackSurface: One whole-book feedback surface after the manuscript, themed only by color and type.

contentsStyle: Drawer uses scoped accent border, active row wash, and manuscript-derived jump labels.
feedbackStyle: Natural-height mobile expansion, no nested mobile scroll, full-width mobile fields, existing endpoint and payload.

responsiveAdaptations.mobile: Near full-width page, 17px body text, simplified motif, no horizontal overflow.
responsiveAdaptations.tablet: Centered page with balanced margins and clear hierarchy.
responsiveAdaptations.desktop: Trade-book proportions with subtle edge and shadow.

futureWordMapping.margins: generous inner/outer margins matching reader proportions
futureWordMapping.sectionDividers: translate dual-rule motif to hairline rules

futurePdfMapping.cover: Use higher-resolution artwork if available; current reader cover is a web/display source.
futurePdfMapping.runningElements: Small bottom page numbers; chapter openers begin on new pages

printLimitations: Current official cover source is 1023x1537; useful as a reader and print-reference image but not guaranteed 300 DPI production cover art.
